name: get_file
author: jm33-m0
comment: Download a file from the agent over the FTP route
help: Download one file or directory from the agent to the operator over the FTP route. path is the remote target. filter applies a regex when path is a directory. offset and stream are internal C2 fields and cannot be supplied directly. Use the download_file MCP tool instead of running this BOF yourself.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Resume offset, filled in by the C2 from the partial download

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: FTP stream token, registered by the C2 to receive the upload

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Regex filter when path is a directory
